## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` main @ **`8e3d4a54`**. `ui/` is in the tree, and the Console was built from it. Node 22, pnpm 10.31.0, 4 CPU / 15 GiB container.
- **Build:**
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: 27 s.
  - `turbo build` of the showcase + cli + dogfood closure (`--filter='!@object-ui/*' --filter='!@objectstack/console'`): 70/70 tasks, 7 m 20 s.
  - `pnpm console:build`: 76/76 tasks, 7 m 10 s.
  - `objectstack compile` of examples/app-showcase, once: 5 s. Every boot after that ran with `--no-compile --no-watch`.
- **Boots:** `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa3b/<runner>/<item>.db`, with `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported.
  - Each runner had its own port range: R1 41200–19, R4 41260–79, R5 41280–99, R6 41300–19, R7 41320–39, R8 41340–59.
  - Installs, compiles and package fixtures ran from scratch copies under /tmp (the WS/examples/app-X copy with `packages` and `node_modules` symlinked).
  - Every process was stopped by its process group. The shared tree's `git status` stayed clean, and `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/` holds only `data/`, with no `installed-packages`.
- **Special boots:**
  - `--log-level info` for clauses that read INFO lines;
  - a hand-made isolated, invite-only walled boot (identity-auth.admin-lifecycle-operations clauses 10–12);
  - a `group` posture boot (approvals.decision-action-matrix A9, records-forms.record-discussion-mentions cross-org leg);
  - `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` (studio-authoring.flow-status-matches-runtime A3).
- **Live e2e:** a Console vite dev server on :5180 proxying through `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` to a backend on :41180, Playwright chromium from the image.
- **Execution:** in parallel. Six runner subagents (opus, effort high), at most 3 at a time, each with its own ports, DBs and browser contexts. Tier 1 pins ran centrally in one sequential pass.
- **Restart:** a container restart at about 10:22Z killed three runners (R5, R7, R8) mid-item, before they had written any verdict. All three were re-dispatched from scratch at 10:24Z. The tree and builds survived.
- **Timestamps (UTC):**
  - setup 09:10–09:27;
  - Tier 1 pins 09:27–09:46, live e2e 09:46–09:56;
  - runners 09:27–12:01 (R4 09:27–10:07, R6 09:27–10:18, R7 10:24–11:12, R8 10:24–11:23, R1 11:13–11:39, R5 10:24–12:01).
- **Wall-clock:** setup 17 min; testing about 2 h 35 min, including about 55 runner-minutes lost to the restart.

## Fails — reproduction rules and dispositions

**access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report · A1:** security finding. Detail withheld, reported to PM.

**records-forms.saved-view-management · A1 (set-default half), N2:** product defect, card draft `card-B-browser-1.md`. Reproduced 2× on fresh loads, the second with a fresh view.
1. Stock showcase at 8e3d4a54, `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, admin.
2. Create a published list view on showcase_task: in the console, or with `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_x {name, object:'showcase_task', viewKind:'list', label, config:{type:'grid', columns:['title'], data:{provider:'object', object:'showcase_task'}}}` → 200.
3. Tasks → view switcher → Manage views → "Set as Default" on it (`data-testid=manage-views-default-<view>`).
4. Network:
   - `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.default` (the shipped All Tasks with `isDefault:false`, no `?package=`) → 403, the refusal naming `com.example.showcase.custom`;
   - then `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.qa_x` (`isDefault:true`) → 200;
   - the console toasts "Failed to save …".
5. Expected: the old default is unset, or the whole operation is refused. Actual: after reload both views carry DEFAULT, and `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=showcase_task` returns both `isDefault`.

Mechanism: `setDefaultViewPatches` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTabs.ts:482`) → `updateView` (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:6837`) saves package-less, and ADR-0146 D11 refuses that write for a shipped item.

**approvals.record-page-decisions · A4:** stale spec. The re-point card **#33060** (round 2, `card-p2-1.md`) has not landed: the item is still rev 5 at 8e3d4a54. Reproduced 4× (/approve, /reject, the action door, and a fresh session).
- A contributor member reads the project but holds no slot on the exec_review request, and forges `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/ID/approve`.
- Expected (clause): 403 FORBIDDEN. Actual: 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, and the request stays pending.
- This is by design: `ApprovalService.refuseUnreadableRequest` (packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts:10090) answers a non-reader exactly as it answers a missing id.

**studio-authoring.flow-status-matches-runtime · A1:** stale spec. The re-point card **#33054** (round 2, `card-browser-5.md`) has not landed: the item is still rev 5.
- Default boot, a writable package with a published schedule flow; `GET /api/v1/automation/_status` reads `unboundCause "deployment_policy"`.
- Expected (clause): the rail and header titles carry the platform reason verbatim.
- Actual: they carry the worded cause, and the verbatim reason is the Problems note's detail. This is deliberate in `describeFlowRunStatus` (ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-problems.ts).
- A0, A2 and A3 pass on both boots. On the scheduled-work boot, the schedule flow reads "Switched on", `bound:true`, and a run completed.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

Every runner kept a probe budget after each item's clauses, typically 3–6 minutes per item: boundary values, opposite postures, and readers outside the asserted scope. The per-item minutes, doors and findings are in each clause comment's "Probe log". The product defects found are extracted as card drafts:

| draft | defect | from |

| card-B-browser-2.md | the activation door's 409 for a queue / sharing rule / assignment rule held by two packages says "address it by its package", but the door has no package qualifier for those types | access-security.sharing-queue-assignment-package-resolution |
| card-B-browser-3.md | validate_expression and the publish gate accept a formula that reads another formula field, and it reads null on every row | studio-authoring.expression-editors |

Observations not filed (recorded in the probe logs):
- decision comments accept 20,001 characters;
- for a non-admin, the approval deep link keeps the `setup` alias in the URL;
- the doc tree door answers 200 with empty groups for an unknown book;
- DELETE on a draft-only flow does nothing (the draft needs discard-drafts);
- DELETE on a code-only picklist answers 200 and does nothing;
- the default metadata-diagnostics sweep skips connector, webhook and analytics_cube (they are missing from `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`);
- the Setup audit-log Record column shows raw ids;
- Undo import gives no toast;
- the Create View dialog says Map is unavailable on showcase_task although the object has a `location` field.

## Parked-on #32908

Checklist-accuracy notes and fixture gaps. No cards; the full text is under each item in the clause comments.

- **approvals:**
  - request-page A1's 403 holds only for a member who can read the request; a stock non-reader gets 404, and the run proved the clause with a reader-tier member.
  - request-page A2's grant leg works with a runtime set plus a binding, so its `blocked(fixture)` fallback can go.
  - quorum steps[4] and decision-matrix A6 say 403 for a non-reader, but this build answers 404.
  - notification-deep-link lands under `com.objectstack.setup`, not `com.objectstack.account`.
  - record-page-decisions A1/A2 decide through `/api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_*`.
  - decision-action-matrix: the seeded Data Platform project refuses a budget of 200000 ("Spend exceeds 120% of budget"), so the run used projects it created.
- **access-security / identity / cli:**
  - security-catalog A4's "≤50 names" is really ≤50 grant ids per org; the set-name map is uncapped, and all 51 names printed.
  - readonly-package-locks-studio A0: the Form tab stays editable on a read-only base by design, because it edits the `.custom` pair.
  - permission-set-package-resolution: name an object no stock member set grants.
  - invitation-scope-gates: a delegated_admin can be minted over HTTP (invite as delegated_admin → sign up → accept).
  - admin-lifecycle A4: the target must change its password first, or it gets 403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED.
  - capability-declaration-lifecycle: the showcase_ops clone lands in `com.example.showcase.custom`, not package-less.
  - cli.address-grammar-reserved-names step 4 / A3: `os dev` refuses a literal namespace at its boot compile; the leg passes on `os serve --dev`.
  - `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` still boots the shared tree without `--no-compile` (L335).
- **records-forms:**
  - record-discussion-mentions A7 needs an object with field history;
  - delete-toast-undo-restore S4 should point at All Tasks;
  - action-preflight-panel's fixture needs an object on the default record page (the task page lists its header actions explicitly);
  - gantt-interactions and action-preflight passed only on fixtures extended by metadata overlays, reverted afterwards.
- **studio-authoring:**
  - picklist-bound-select N0, read literally, fails a plain REST GET→PUT round-trip ("picklist and options cannot both be declared", 422). The console strips the options, so the clause should say it covers the designer's PUTs only.
  - picklist fixture: a /tmp copy with symlinked `packages` and `node_modules` works in place of a worktree plus install.
  - access-owd-and-suggestions knownGaps[1] is stale: Reconsider calls `/suggested-bindings/:id/reopen`.
  - no-entry-property-matrix row 8 should point displayNameField at a field the heuristic would not pick, and row 11 needs user/lookup roster pointers.
- **platform-core / ux:**
  - marketplace-console-honesty steps[4]: a member cannot open Setup, so the member legs used `/apps/com.example.showcase/system/marketplace`. The catalog leg (not a clause) answered 502 MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED because the egress proxy refuses cloud.objectos.ai.
  - labels-over-machine-names knownGaps[0] (Explain "Contributed by" chips, objectui#13056) did not reproduce, and knownGaps[2] cites `http_request`, which spec 18 removed.
  - write-feedback: the Studio publish toast names a count, not the package label; variants[6] lands on the expense record's own page.
- **Environment facts for RUNNER.md:** the vite live console must use `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, not `VITE_SERVER_URL` (Tier 1 note above). A runner should write its result file item by item: a container restart lost three runners' in-flight work this round.

Cost: this session's `cost_usd` at 12:04Z was **$93.33**, including the 9 runner subagent dispatches (3 of them lost to the restart).
